text: Child wonders where and why her mother went. Whole communities not fed. Declare martial law instead. Derailed all progress and action. The Congress course lies. Tide rise. Tore through. Let bellies levy. A saturated heart stays heavy. Can't help but wonder if my master stand ready. Revolutions course lies. But a knot on mine's deadly.
